transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Yeah, um… the main thing is I just can’t seem to stay on track. Like, I’ll sit down and try to do something important, like work on an application or fill something out, and I swear I’ll have every intention of doing it, but then the smallest thing pulls me away.

It can be a car going by outside, or my phone lighting up, or even just some random thought that pops into my head. And then before I even realize it, I’m not doing the thing anymore. I’ll be on some totally different website, or looking something up that only kind of relates, or I’ll get up for no real reason. It’s like my attention gets yanked away before I can catch it.

And it’s frustrating because it’s not like I’m choosing to waste time. I’ll start out thinking, “Okay, I’m going to finish this,” and then twenty minutes later I’m like, wait, how did I end up doing this instead? That’s mostly why I’m here, because it keeps happening and it’s getting hard to deal with.
Do you often feel restless or find yourself needing to move around, even when you’re trying to focus or stay still?

Yeah, definitely. That’s actually been really noticeable lately. I used to play soccer, and that was kind of where a lot of my energy went, I guess. Since I can’t really do that like I used to, being stuck around the house feels awful sometimes.

Like, I’ll try to sit down and focus on something, or even just sit and relax, and after a little while it feels like I’m crawling out of my skin. I don’t even always have a reason to get up, but I’ll just start pacing from room to room. I’ll go from the living room to the kitchen, then back, then maybe to my room, and I’m not really doing anything productive. I just feel like I have to move or I get really uncomfortable.

It’s not even always that I’m trying to go somewhere or do something specific. It’s more like sitting still starts to feel impossible, like my body is buzzing or something, and pacing is the only thing that takes the edge off a little.
Have you found yourself acting on impulse or doing things without really thinking about them first, like making sudden decisions or interrupting others before you mean to?

Yeah… yeah, I do that a lot, honestly. The biggest thing is I cut people off when they’re talking. Like with my mom, especially, or with the counselor I’ve talked to before, they’ll be in the middle of explaining something or asking me something, and it’s like an answer pops into my head and I feel like I have to say it right then.

It’s not even always that I mean to be rude. Most of the time I don’t. I’ll realize halfway through that they weren’t actually done talking yet, but by then I’ve already jumped in. Sometimes I’ll start answering the first part of what they said before they finish the rest, and then I’m kind of embarrassed because it’s obvious I interrupted.

I think part of it is I worry if I don’t say it immediately, I’ll lose the thought. So I just blurt it out. But yeah, it happens enough that people notice, especially my mom.
